page2_groups.title: A
questions: The teacher introduces two new students.
方友朋喜欢跟爸爸一起
Fang Youpeng likes swimming with Dad.
Zhang Li is seven years old this year.
They come to Chinese school to study Chinese.

page2_groups.title: B
questions: The two new students introduce themselves.
Fang Youpeng is a new student.
Dawen is happy to meet the new students.

page4_questions.q: 请问今天有几个新同学？
page4_questions.en: How many new classmates are there today?

page4_questions.q: 方友朋喜欢跟谁一起游泳？
page4_questions.en: Who does Fang Youpeng like swimming with?
What does Zhang Li prefer doing?
Who is Li Dawen happy to meet?

page7_charRows.en: I am eight this year and prefer playing ball.
I like to draw pictures with my little brother.

rows: Zhang Li dislikes summer the most.

page9_trueFalse: 大文今天认识了一个男生，一个女生。
Dawen met one boy and one girl today.
Zhang Li is eight this year.
大文觉得张莉很喜欢运动。
Dawen thinks Zhang Li likes sports.
大文很想跟友朋一起游泳。
Dawen really wants to swim with Youpeng.
content.page9_passage: 今天大文在中文学校认识了两个新同学，男生叫方友朋，女生叫张莉。友朋今年八岁，喜欢跟他爸爸一起游泳。张莉今年七岁，她比较喜欢看书。大文觉得方友朋很喜欢运动，可是张莉不喜欢。大文很想跟新同学方友朋一起打球。

_editingGuide.purpose: Edit answerKeys to change the expected answers. The HTML reconstructs keys into quiz questions when loading.
_editingGuide.page1_listening: Each object maps zero-based word positions (as strings) to circle, triangle, or square. Unlisted positions expect no marking.
_editingGuide.page1_pictures: One zero-based picture choice per question.
_editingGuide.page2_fill: Rows correspond to Section A/B, columns to question order. Answers are vocabulary strings from the word bank.
_editingGuide.page3_listening: Zero-based selected option index for each listening question.
_editingGuide.page4_comprehension: Zero-based selected option index for each question.
_editingGuide.page5_vocabulary: Zero-based selected option index for each listening word.
_editingGuide.page5_sentences: Zero-based selected option index for each comprehension sentence.
_editingGuide.page6_matching: Pinyin answer strings in order of the characters in page6_matches.
_editingGuide.page6_radicals: Common-component answer strings in question order; these are collected for teacher review (not auto-graded).
_editingGuide.page7_writing: Character answer arrays for each writing sentence, in blank order.
_editingGuide.page8_fill: Vocabulary strings for each group and sentence.
_editingGuide.page9_true_false: true or false for each comprehension statement.
